items.item: A fresh or unstable Row ID uniquely identifies the row within one version of the table and may change every time the table is updated, even for rows that are not modified

items.item: A stable Row ID uniquely identifies the row across versions of the table and across updates; when a row is updated or copied, the stable Row ID for this row is preserved

items.item: The default generated Row ID for a data file is calculated by adding the file's baseRowId to the physical position of the row within the file, and is reassigned every time a row is updated or moved to a different file

items.item: Before committing, Delta checks whether the proposed changes conflict with anything committed since the snapshot that was read; with no conflict the write succeeds, with a conflict it fails with a concurrent modification exception

items.item: Delta Lake updates a table by rewriting whole data files, so a MERGE updating a few rows must also rewrite every unmodified row in that file
